purpose: Post-hoc banknote boundary annotation for controlled ROI calibration analysis in Thesis Subsection 5.7.2
containment_rule: All four verified banknote polygon vertices must be inside the candidate ROI. Source-truncated samples are not fully contained for any candidate ROI.
background_rule: For a source-complete banknote that is fully contained by a candidate ROI, excessive background is flagged when banknote occupancy is below 0.50 (equivalently background ratio above 0.50).
nonmoney_rule: Nonmoney samples are not boundary-annotated; they remain available for the later eight-class model-performance comparison.
review_policy: All 210 nominal ROI samples must be human-reviewed. Automatic boundaries are proposals only and never become final without review.
